mapper.select: SELECT lc.settle_status AS settleStatus , count(lc.contract_id) AS contractCount , round(count(lc.contract_id) / (SELECT count(*) FROM lon_contract lcc where lcc.data_class='NORMAL' and lcc.company_id=#{request.companyId}) * 100,0) AS contractCountPercent , ( SELECT count(contract_id) FROM lon_contract lcc where lcc.data_class='NORMAL' and lcc.company_id=#{request.companyId} ) AS contractSumCount , ( SELECT count(contract_id) FROM lon_contract lcc where lcc.data_class='NORMAL' and lcc.creation_date >(CURDATE() - DAY(CURDATE()) + 1) and lcc.company_id=#{request.companyId} ) AS currentMonthAppend FROM lon_contract lc where lc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lc.company_id=#{request.companyId} GROUP BY lc.settle_status

(select scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'FCT.CREDIT_TYPE' and scv.value = hcl.document_type) document_type2_n,
hcl.document_type document_type2,
(select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'LON.CREDIT_CATEGORY' and scv.value = lc.document_type) document_type_n,
lccl.credit_category, lccl.withdraw_deadline, hcl.credit_line_amt, calc.actual_available_amt open_to_buy, nvl(calc.credit_exposure_amt , 0) credit_exposure_amt, nvl(calc.withdraw_balance,0) withdraw_balance, hcl.valid_from, hcl.valid_to, hcl.first_withdraw_date, hcl.delay_from, hcl.delay_to, hcl.competent_dept, hcl.finance_type,
( SELECT hdt.description FROM hls_document_type hdt WHERE hdt.document_category = hcl.document_category AND hdt.document_type = hcl.document_type AND hdt.business_type = hcl.business_type ) credit_line_desc , cba.bank_account_name withdraw_bank_account_name , cba.bank_account_num withdraw_bank_account_number , cba.bank_account_name repayment_bank_account_name , cba.bank_account_num repayment_bank_account_number , ( SELECT ca.bank_name FROM csh_bank ca WHERE ca.bank_id = cba.bank_id) withdraw_bank_name, cba.bank_branch_name withdraw_bank_branch_name, lcc.currency credit_currency_code, (SELECT fc.currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc WHERE fc.currency_code = lc.currency) currency_n, nvl(withdraw.due_amount,0) withdraw_approved_amount, case when lc.con_release_flag='Y' then (lc.finance_amount - nvl(withdraw.surplus_amount,0)) else (lc.finance_amount - nvl(withdraw.due_amount,0)) end withdraw_left_amount FROM lon_contract lc left join hls_credit_line hcl on hcl.credit_line_id = lc.credit_line_id left join lon_credit_line_calc calc on calc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id left join lon_credit_contract_line lccl on lccl.credit_line_id=hcl.credit_line_id left join lon_credit_contract lcc on lcc.credit_contract_id = lccl.credit_contract_id left join lon_credit_contract oldcre on oldcre.credit_contract_id=lc.credit_contract_id left join hls_bp_master hbm on hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id left join csh_bank_account cba on cba.bank_account_id = lc.repayment_bank_account_id left join ( select lcw.contract_id, sum(lcw.due_amount) due_amount, sum(lcw.due_amount-nvl(lr.write_off_amount,0)) surplus_amount from lon_contract_withdraw lcw left join ( select lcr.withdraw_id, nvl(sum(lcr.write_off_amount),0) write_off_amount from lon_contract_repayment lcr where lcr.cf_item=301 group by lcr.withdraw_id) lr on lcw.withdraw_id=lr.withdraw_id where lcw.data_class='NORMAL' and lcw.withdraw_status in('APPROVED','PENDING') group by lcw.contract_id ) withdraw on withdraw.contract_id=lc.contract_id
1=1
and lc.contract_id = #{contractId}
AND lc.contract_status = #{contractStatus}
ORDER BY lc.contract_id DESC

nvl(LC.FINANCE_AMOUNT,0)-(nvl(CW.DUE_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CW.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT,0)) ELSE nvl(LC.FINANCE_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CW.DUE_AMOUNT,0) END withdraw_left_amount, (SELECT fc.currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc lc left join ( SELECT LCW.CONTRACT_ID, SUM(LCW.DUE_AMOUNT) DUE_AMOUNT, MAX(LCW.APPROVAL_DATE) APPROVAL_DATE, SUM(LCR.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT) WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW LEFT JOIN (SELECT CR.WITHDRAW_ID,nvl(SUM(CR.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT),0) WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT FROM LON_CONTRACT_REPAYMENT CR WHERE CR.CF_ITEM=301 GROUP BY CR.WITHDRAW_ID) LCR ON LCR.WITHDRAW_ID=LCW.WITHDRAW_ID WHERE LCW.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS IN('APPROVED','PENDING') GROUP BY LCW.CONTRACT_ID ) CW ON LC.CONTRACT_ID=CW.CONTRACT_ID left join hls_credit_line hcl on hcl.credit_line_id = sc where sc.CODE = 'LON.CREDIT_CATEGORY' and sc.code_value=lc.document_type ) document_type_desc, lc.credit_bp_id, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id) credit_bp_name from lon_contract lc lc.contract_status = 'APPROVED' and lc.data_class = 'NORMAL'

mapper.update: update lon_contract lc set lc.settle_status='CLEARED' where lc.settle_status='UNCLEARED' and (select count(1) from lon_contract_withdraw cw where cw.contract_id=lc.contract_id and cw.withdraw_status!='APPROVED' and cw.data_class='NORMAL')=0 and lc.finance_amount <= ( select sum((case when lcp.cf_item = 301 then lcp.write_off_amount else 0 end)) from lon_contract_withdraw lcw join lon_contract_repayment lcp on lcp.withdraw_id=lcw.withdraw_id where lcw.contract_id=lc.contract_id and lcw.data_class='NORMAL' and lcw.withdraw_status='APPROVED' and lcp.write_off_flag='FULL' ) and ( select count(1) from lon_contract_repayment cr, lon_contract_withdraw cw where cr.withdraw_id=cw.withdraw_id and cw.contract_id=lc.contract_id and cw.data_class='NORMAL' and nvl(cr.write_off_flag,'NOT')!='FULL') =0
mapper.select: select count(1) from lon_contract lc join lon_contract_withdraw lcw on lcw.contract_id=lc.contract_id where lcw.data_class='NORMAL' and lcw.withdraw_status in ('APPROVED','PENDING','APPROVING') and lc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT ( SELECT min( lcw.due_date ) FROM lon_contract_withdraw lcw WHERE lcw.CONTRACT_ID = lc.CONTRACT_ID ) AS FINANCING_TERM_FROM, ( SELECT max( lcw.withdraw_end_date ) FROM lon_contract_withdraw lcw WHERE lcw.CONTRACT_ID = lc.CONTRACT_ID ) AS FINANCING_TERM_TO, ( SELECT sum( lcw.due_amount ) FROM lon_contract_withdraw lcw WHERE lcw.CONTRACT_ID = lc.CONTRACT_ID ) AS FINANCE_AMOUNT FROM lon_contract lc WHERE lc.contract_id = #{contractId}
